title: Zephyr: access level enforcement
close_reason: Already implemented: lichen_coap_is_local_admin() in coap_keys.c provides transport-based access control (loopback/SLIP=admin, mesh=rejected). Used across all write operations (PUT/DELETE) in coap_config.c, coap_keys.c, coap_server.c, etc. Test suite in tests/coap_lci_auth validates behavior.
